purpose: Teach: 文中/合弁/集大成/係長/特設/別冊/交替/年率

lines.speaker: hiroshi_elder
lines.jp: お父さん、創業時、契約書の文中表現に厳しかったぞ
lines.en: When we were founding the company, your father was strict about every word in the contracts.
lines.style: Quiet, measured reflection. Slight pause between clauses. Warm regard underneath the recollection. The tone of someone sharing something worth remembering.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: はい。お父さんは海外合弁の道を切り開かれた
lines.en: Yes. Father really did pioneer the path into international joint ventures for us.
lines.style: Respectful acknowledgment. Steady pace, grounded. A slight deepening on 「開かれた」—recognizing the magnitude of the step. Composed, honoring.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_elder
lines.jp: お父さん、二十周年式典を集大成として行われたぞ
lines.en: The twentieth-anniversary ceremony—he made that the culmination of everything he'd built.
lines.style: Gentle, contemplative. A soft wistfulness on the opening. Slight trailing-off at the end, letting the weight of the accomplishment settle. The voice of someone seeing it from a distance now.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: はい。お父さんは係長時代から現場感覚を磨かれた
lines.en: Yes. Even back when he was just a section chief, he was honing his instinct for what happened on the ground.
lines.style: Thoughtful, almost understated. Even pace, but with a quiet conviction beneath it. A small nod in the voice on 「磨かれた」—acknowledging the gradual shaping of something solid.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_elder
lines.jp: お父さん、新商品発表で特設会場を借りられたぞ
lines.en: When he launched the new product line, he rented a special venue for it—really made an occasion of it.
lines.style: Nostalgic wonder in the opening. Slower pace, savoring the memory. A slight lift at 「特設会場」—the pride of that gesture. Trailing warmly into recollection.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: はい。お父さんは社内報の別冊で社員の声を伝えられた
lines.en: Yes. And through the company newsletter supplement, he made sure the staff's voices were heard.
lines.style: Steady, reflective. A quiet certainty in the voice. Slight emphasis on 「社員の声」—the care he took with that. Composed, honoring the human side of his leadership.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_elder
lines.jp: お父さん、社員の交替制シフトを工夫されたぞ
lines.en: He was creative with the shift schedules too—he really thought through how to make it work fairly for everyone.
lines.style: Soft admiration. Gentle pace. A warmth on 「工夫」—the ingenuity behind something practical. Trailing into quiet recognition of an understated kindness.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: はい。お父さんは融資の年率交渉に強かった
lines.en: Yes. He had a real knack for negotiating those loan rates—he always knew how to get us the terms we needed.
lines.style: Measured, knowing. A solid confidence in the voice without boasting. Final statement—clear, present, closing with quiet respect. The finality of someone who witnessed it.
